title: Hello CLO Community
content:
Hi everyone, my name is Paria, a digital fashion designer passionate about creating elegant and modern womens wear in CLO3D.

My signature style blends origami-inspired shapes with transparent and semi-transparent materials, creating minimal yet functional designs with a touch of femininity.

Excited to share my works here and connect with other designers in the CLO community! 💙

title: How to Attach an Object to Fabric and Use Glue in CLO3D
content:
Hi everyone,

I’m working on a shoe design in CLO3D and I’m having some trouble. I want to attach tennis balls to the sole, but I’m not sure how to make the object stick properly to the fabric. I’ve heard about using the “Glue” feature, but I don’t fully understand how to apply it.

  1. What should I pay attention to when attaching an object to fabric?

  2. How exactly should I use the Glue feature step by step?

  3. If I need to slightly embed the object and use “Superimpose,” how can I do this correctly?




Any advice or tips from your experience would be greatly appreciated.

Thanks!
content_description: This webpage aims to provide guidance on effectively using the "Glue" feature in CLO3D to attach objects, like tennis balls, to fabric in shoe design projects.
